extracted.name: Garlic Cheese Flatbread
extracted.description: This tasty garlic and cheese flatbread is made on pizza dough with no rolling pin required! It’s perfect alongside soup or a salad, and it also makes a great snack.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C). Lightly grease a 10x15-inch baking sheet.
Press dough onto the prepared baking sheet. Combine butter, garlic, and basil in a small bowl; drizzle over dough. Sprinkle with Cheddar, Romano, and Parmesan.
Bake in the preheated oven until crisp, 10 to 12 minutes. Cut into 12 squares and serve warm.
